newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan January forex reserves up to US$88.393 bln.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan January forex reserves up to US$88.393 bln.

text.p: Taiwan's foreign exchange reserves rose to US$88.393 billion at the end of January from $88.038 billion at the end of December 1996, the central bank said on Monday.
The central bank intervened during the crisis to support the Taiwan dollar and the island's hypersensitive stock market.
Taiwan's foreign reserves peaked 19 months ago at $100.412 billion in June 1995, just as tensions with China erupted over President Lee Teng-hui's controversial private visit to the United States.
Note - Foreign currency reserves in billions of U.S. dollars.
